symptom: PC-Sales-1 in Engineering wing cannot reach Accounting Server at 192.168.10.100. Local gateway ping fails.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Interface FastEthernet0/5 is improperly assigned to VLAN 20 (Guest) instead of VLAN 10 (Sales).
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Access Port VLAN Assignment failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: CDP native VLAN mismatch warnings flooding console; inter-switch management traffic is dropping packets.

rule_findings.matched_text: %CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH: Native VLAN mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/1 (99), with SW-Dist1 GigabitEthernet0/1 (1)
rule_findings.description: Native VLAN mismatch: Local GigabitEthernet0/1 is on Native VLAN 99, but remote SW-Dist1 GigabitEthernet0/1 is on Native VLAN 1.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Configure matching native VLANs: 'switchport trunk native vlan 99' on SW-Dist1.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Native VLAN mismatch on 802.1Q trunk link Gi0/1: SW-Core1 is configured with Native VLAN 99, while SW-Dist1 is on default Native VLAN 1.
evidence: %CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH: Native VLAN mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/1 (99), with SW-Dist1 GigabitEthernet0/1 (1).
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Native VLAN Mismatch failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: VLAN 20 and VLAN 30 hosts on Access Switch SW-2 cannot communicate with Default Gateway located on Core Switch SW-1.

rule_findings.rule_name: Trunk Link Inactive / Static Access Mode
rule_findings.matched_text:
Administrative Mode: dynamic auto
Operational Mode: static access
rule_findings.description: Inter-switch link failed to negotiate 802.1Q trunking and fell back to static access mode.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Hardcode trunk mode: 'switchport mode trunk' and 'switchport trunk allowed vlan ...'

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Uplink interface GigabitEthernet0/1 on SW-2 is operating in static access mode because DTP failed or administrative mode was not hardcoded to trunk.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing Trunk Mode Configuration failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Hosts in VLAN 30 (192.168.30.0/24) cannot reach default gateway 192.168.30.1 on Router R1. VLAN 10 and 20 work fine.

rule_findings.description: Interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.30 is physically up but Line Protocol is down. Indicates Layer 2 framing, dot1Q missing encapsulation, or keepalive failure.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Verify 802.1Q encapsulation ('encapsulation dot1Q <vlan>') or clock rate/framing on GigabitEthernet0/0/0.30.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Sub-interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.30 is missing IEEE 802.1Q encapsulation ('encapsulation dot1Q 30'), leaving the protocol status down.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Router-on-a-Stick Dot1Q Encapsulation failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Users connected to switch ports configured for VLAN 40 (Voice) get no link layer connectivity and traffic is blackholed.

rule_findings.matched_text: Port assigned to VLAN 40, but VLAN 40 absent from 'show vlan brief'
rule_findings.description: Switch ports are assigned to VLAN 40, but VLAN 40 has not been created in the switch VLAN database.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Create VLAN in global config: 'vlan 40' -> 'name <name>' -> 'state active'.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: VLAN 40 has not been created in the local switch VLAN database, causing all ports assigned to VLAN 40 to remain inactive.
evidence: (VLAN 40 is missing from the VLAN database)
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing VLAN in Database failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Clients in VLAN 20 receive APIPA addresses (169.254.x.x) and cannot lease an IP address from centralized DHCP Server at 192.168.10.50.

rule_findings.description: Host has IP 192.168.20.1 but no default gateway (0.0.0.0) configured. Cannot reach remote subnets.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Configure valid default gateway on host or add 'default-router' option to DHCP pool.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Router sub-interface Gi0/0.20 lacks the 'ip helper-address 192.168.10.50' configuration required to relay DHCP broadcast requests to the DHCP server.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing IP Helper Address failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: New branch office workstations cannot obtain DHCP leases. Existing workstations retain current leases.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: DHCP excluded address range is overly broad (192.168.50.1 to 192.168.50.250), leaving only 4 usable IP addresses in the pool.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified DHCP Pool Scope Exclusion & Exhaustion failure at Layer 7. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Static workstation PC-HQ can ping local peers on 192.168.1.0/24 but fails to reach any external server or internet IP.

rule_findings.matched_text: Host Gateway: 192.168.1.254 vs Router Interface IP: 192.168.1.1
rule_findings.description: Host is configured with gateway 192.168.1.254, but router gateway on this segment is 192.168.1.1.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Workstation default gateway is misconfigured as 192.168.1.254 instead of the actual router gateway IP 192.168.1.1.
recommended_fix: (Or in Packet Tracer GUI: Desktop -> IP Configuration -> Default Gateway: 192.168.1.1)
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Default Gateway Typo failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: DHCP clients in VLAN 10 acquire valid IP address and subnet mask, but cannot access destinations outside their local subnet.

rule_findings.description: Host has IP 192.168.10.25 but no default gateway (0.0.0.0) configured. Cannot reach remote subnets.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Configure valid default gateway on host or add 'default-router' option to DHCP pool.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: DHCP pool 'LAN_VLAN10' is missing the 'default-router 192.168.10.1' configuration parameter, causing clients to have no default gateway.
evidence: R1# show running-config | section ip dhcp pool
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing Default-Router Option failure at Layer 7. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Intermittent gateway reachability and ARP flapping observed across all workstations in the Finance department.

rule_findings.description: Duplicate IP address 192.168.100.1 detected on interface GigabitEthernet0/1. ARP flapping occurs when two hosts claim the same IP.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Inspect switch MAC address table for conflicting MAC and reassign unique IP on rogue device.

rule_findings.description: IP 192.168.100.1 is claimed by multiple distinct MAC addresses (0000.0c07.ac01, 0001.9654.abcd).
rule_findings.suggested_action: Isolate conflicting host port and clear ARP cache.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: IP address conflict: A rogue host with MAC 0001.9654.abcd has been statically assigned 192.168.100.1, conflicting with the default router gateway.
evidence: %IP-4-DUPADDR: Duplicate address 192.168.100.1 on GigabitEthernet0/1, sourced by 0001.9654.abcd
recommended_fix: 1. Identify port for MAC 0001.9654.abcd on switch: 'show mac address-table address 0001.9654.abcd'
2. Reconfigure or change host IP on rogue endpoint to an unused IP (e.g., 192.168.100.250).
3. Clear ARP cache on router: 'clear arp-cache'
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Duplicate IP / Gateway Conflict failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Branch router R-BR1 cannot route remote branch traffic to HQ subnet 10.0.0.0/8. Pings drop with 'Destination host unreachable'.

rule_findings.description: Static route next-hop 172.16.1.6 does not reside in the connected /30 point-to-point interface subnet of 172.16.1.1.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Change static route next-hop to the neighbor interface IP on the same /30 subnet.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Static route points to 172.16.1.6, which is an invalid next-hop outside the /30 point-to-point subnet (172.16.1.0/30 allows only .1 and .2).
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Invalid Static Route Next-Hop failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: OSPF adjacency fails to form between Core Router R1 and Distribution Router R2 across GigabitEthernet0/1.

rule_findings.rule_name: OSPF Passive Interface on Adjacency Link
rule_findings.description: Interface GigabitEthernet0/1 is configured as passive in OSPF, suppressing Hello packets and preventing neighbor adjacency.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: GigabitEthernet0/1 on R1 is mistakenly configured as a passive interface ('passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1'), preventing OSPF Hello packet exchange.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified OSPF Passive Interface Misconfiguration failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: OSPF adjacency stuck in INIT/DOWN state between Router R1 and Router R2 on link 192.168.12.0/30.

rule_findings.matched_text: %OSPF-4-ERRRCV: Received packet with invalid area ID 0.0.0.1 from 192.168.12.2 on GigabitEthernet0/0 area 0.0.0.0
rule_findings.description: OSPF Area mismatch: Received Hello with Area 0.0.0.1 on interface configured for Area 0.0.0.0.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Align OSPF network area definitions so both neighboring interfaces share the same Area ID.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: OSPF Area ID mismatch on connecting link: R1 interface is in Area 0 while R2 interface is in Area 1.
evidence: %OSPF-4-ERRRCV: Received packet with invalid area ID 0.0.0.1 from 192.168.12.2 on GigabitEthernet0/0 area 0.0.0.0
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified OSPF Area Mismatch failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Subnet 172.16.20.0/24 on Router R1 is not being advertised to OSPF neighbors.

rule_findings.description: Subnet mask format '255.255.255.0' used in OSPF network command instead of inverted wildcard mask.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Use inverted wildcard mask (e.g. replace 255.255.255.0 with 0.0.0.255).

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Subnet mask '255.255.255.0' was entered instead of inverted wildcard mask '0.0.0.255' in the OSPF network statement, so Gi0/2 was never enabled for OSPF.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified OSPF Wildcard Mask Error failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Clients in Branch Subnet 192.168.70.0/24 can send packets to HQ Server 10.10.10.50, but receive no reply.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: HQ-Core router lacks a return route for the branch subnet 192.168.70.0/24, causing return packets to be dropped.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing Return Route / Asymmetric Routing failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Engineering workstations in 192.168.10.0/24 cannot browse Web Server at 192.168.20.80. ICMP ping works.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: ACL 101 permits only ICMP traffic; HTTP (TCP port 80) and HTTPS (TCP port 443) traffic is blocked by the implicit 'deny ip any any' at the end of the ACL.
evidence: (Implicit deny ip any any active at end)
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Implicit Deny All Blocking HTTP failure at Layer 4. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: ACL intended to protect Internal DB from external network is blocking internal DB requests instead.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Access list FILTER_EXT_IN was applied as 'in' on internal interface Gi0/0 instead of 'in' on external WAN interface Gi0/1.
recommended_fix: R-Edge(config-if)# no ip access-group FILTER_EXT_IN in
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified ACL Direction Misapplication (In vs Out) failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Clients cannot connect to Web Server port 80 through perimeter firewall router.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Port specification 'eq 80' was applied to the source port (client random ephemeral port) instead of the destination port.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified ACL Port Matching Reversal (Source vs Destination) failure at Layer 4. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Standard ACL designed to block Host A from accessing Server B inadvertently blocked Host A from accessing the entire enterprise network.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Standard ACL 10 was placed at the source ingress interface Gi0/0, blocking Host A from all destinations instead of placing an Extended ACL close to the destination.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Standard ACL Placement Flaw failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Large packets drop silently and network engineers cannot perform diagnostic ping/traceroute across WAN link.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Rule 30 explicitly denies all ICMP traffic, preventing echo-reply and ICMP Type 3 Code 4 (Fragmentation Needed) packets.
recommended_fix: R-WAN1(config-ext-nacl)# 30 permit icmp any any unreachable
R-WAN1(config-ext-nacl)# 35 permit icmp any any echo-reply
R-WAN1(config-ext-nacl)# 36 permit icmp any any time-exceeded
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified ACL Blocking ICMP Diagnostic & PMTU failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Internal clients on LAN cannot access internet hosts; `show ip nat translations` is completely empty.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Interface GigabitEthernet0/0 (LAN) is missing the 'ip nat inside' configuration directive.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing IP NAT Inside Directive failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: LAN clients have 'ip nat inside' on internal interface, but packets are routed out to ISP with un-translated private IPs.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Interface Serial0/0/0 (WAN) is missing the 'ip nat outside' configuration statement.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing IP NAT Outside Directive failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Only the first single host that accesses the internet works; all subsequent client connections fail completely.

rule_findings.matched_text: ip nat inside present; missing 'ip nat outside' on WAN interface
rule_findings.description: NAT configuration is active and 'ip nat inside' is present, but no WAN interface has 'ip nat outside'.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Apply 'ip nat outside' to the WAN/ISP facing interface.

rule_findings.matched_text: ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
rule_findings.description: NAT source statement lacks the 'overload' keyword, restricting translation to only 1 single simultaneous client.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Re-enter command with 'overload' appended: 'ip nat inside source list ... overload'.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: The NAT statement is configured as 1-to-1 dynamic NAT without the 'overload' keyword, exhausting the single public IP after one host.
evidence: ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
recommended_fix: R-Gateway(config)# no ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
R-Gateway(config)# ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1 overload
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Missing PAT Overload Keyword failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Users in newly added VLAN 30 (192.168.30.0/24) cannot reach the internet, while VLAN 10 and 20 browse normally.

rule_findings.matched_text: ip nat inside present; missing 'ip nat outside' on WAN interface
rule_findings.description: NAT configuration is active and 'ip nat inside' is present, but no WAN interface has 'ip nat outside'.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Apply 'ip nat outside' to the WAN/ISP facing interface.

rule_findings.matched_text: ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1
rule_findings.description: NAT source statement lacks the 'overload' keyword, restricting translation to only 1 single simultaneous client.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Re-enter command with 'overload' appended: 'ip nat inside source list ... overload'.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Standard ACL 1 referenced by NAT does not permit subnet 192.168.30.0/24, preventing NAT translation for VLAN 30.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified NAT Source ACL Subnet Exclusion failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: External internet clients attempting to reach internal Web Server at public IP 203.0.113.10 port 80 are redirected to SSH port 22.

rule_findings.matched_text: ip nat inside present; missing 'ip nat outside' on WAN interface
rule_findings.description: NAT configuration is active and 'ip nat inside' is present, but no WAN interface has 'ip nat outside'.
rule_findings.suggested_action: Apply 'ip nat outside' to the WAN/ISP facing interface.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Static NAT statement maps external port 80 to internal port 22 (SSH) instead of port 80 (HTTP).
evidence: ip nat inside source static tcp 192.168.5.10 22 203.0.113.10 80 extendable
recommended_fix: R1(config)# no ip nat inside source static tcp 192.168.5.10 22 203.0.113.10 80
R1(config)# ip nat inside source static tcp 192.168.5.10 80 203.0.113.10 80 extendable
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Static NAT Port Translation Conflict failure at Layer 4. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Wireless laptop associates to 'Corporate-WiFi' SSID but cannot obtain an IP address or reach corporate intranet.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Switch port Fa0/12 connected to the AP is configured as access mode on VLAN 1 instead of a trunk port allowing VLAN 50.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Wireless Access Point SSID VLAN Mismatch failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Mobile devices cannot associate with Wireless Router 'Branch-WAP'; client logs indicate 4-Way Handshake Failure.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Client configuration has an incorrect Pre-Shared Key ('CiscoSecure2025') mismatching the AP key ('CiscoSecure2026!').
evidence: Client-Log> 802.1X/WPA 4-Way Handshake: Failed (MIC mismatch / Key incorrect)
recommended_fix: Update client wireless profile with correct Pre-Shared Key: 'CiscoSecure2026!'.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified WPA2 Pre-Shared Key Mismatch failure at Layer 2. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Users can ping external IP 8.8.8.8 successfully but cannot browse 'www.cisco.com' or any domain name.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Client DNS server address is configured as loopback IP 127.0.0.1 instead of the active enterprise DNS server 192.168.1.10.
evidence: *** Can't find server address for '127.0.0.1': No response from server
recommended_fix: (Or in Packet Tracer GUI: Desktop -> IP Configuration -> DNS Server: 192.168.1.10)
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Invalid Client DNS Server Assignment failure at Layer 7. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: All enterprise workstations report 'DNS Server not responding' when resolving local domain records.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: The DNS Server daemon on Server-01 is turned OFF in Packet Tracer service configuration.
recommended_fix: On Server-01 in Cisco Packet Tracer:
2. Toggle DNS Service Radio Button from 'OFF' to 'ON'.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified DNS Service Stopped on Server failure at Layer 7. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.

symptom: Security audit alert: Unauthenticated guest Wi-Fi users in VLAN 90 can ping and access internal financial servers in 10.10.0.0/16.

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Missing guest isolation ACL on sub-interface Gi0/0.90, allowing unrestricted inter-VLAN routing between Guest Wi-Fi and Corporate internal servers.
ai_diagnosis.explanation: Diagnosis identified Guest Wireless Isolation Failure failure at Layer 3. Remediation restores standard Cisco IOS operation.
